features.name: Foundation — Structural Overhaul
features.description: Bring the repo into AGENTS.md compliance. Makefile, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Zustand, uv, black/ruff/prettier/eslint, tests, docs. No feature behavior changes.

tests.notes: Tests written as part of this phase: unit tests for existing backend core/ logic, component render tests for React components

subtasks.name: Create root Makefile with setup/dev/test/style/build/clean targets
Add infra-up/infra-down/dbt-run/eval Makefile targets
Configure uv + pyproject.toml, remove requirements.txt
Configure black + ruff, format/lint all Python
Migrate frontend .jsx -> .tsx with strict tsconfig.json
Install TailwindCSS v4, replace all .css with utility classes
Add Zustand chat store, extract state from components
Configure Prettier + ESLint for frontend
Move config.py from core/ to utils/, clean BaseSettings usage
Write backend pytest tests (mirror core/ and api/v1/)
Write frontend Vitest + RTL tests
Create docs/problem.md

features.notes: This is the longest phase. Every subsequent phase depends on the scaffolding created here. Existing behavior must not regress.

features.name: Rebrand — CaliperLens Everywhere
features.description: Replace all old naming (Caliper, Caliper-SQL-generator) with CaliperLens. Rename GitHub repo. Fix license. Remove dead assets.

tests.notes: Tests: verify title tags, API title, package.json name contain CaliperLens

subtasks.name: Rename GitHub repo Caliper-SQL-generator -> CaliperLens, update remote
Update README clone URLs, title, description to CaliperLens
Update package.json name to caliperlens
Update index.html title tag
Update main.py FastAPI title and version
Update ChatInterface brand text and navbar
Fill LICENSE copyright line, evaluate license change
Remove foresighthealth_logo.jpeg and .png assets
Remove root package-lock.json (empty placeholder)

features.notes: Can execute in parallel with F001 (independent file sets). License: Apache 2.0 is permissive; evaluate proprietary or AGPL if usage restrictions desired.

features.name: LLM Migration — AWS Bedrock to Gemini 3.5 Flash
features.description: Drop AWS Bedrock, standardize on Google Gemini 3.5 Flash for reasoning and text-embedding-004 for embeddings. Clean config. Remove os.environ abuse.

tests.notes: Tests: mock Gemini API, verify agent initializes without AWS, verify settings object has no AWS fields

subtasks.name: Remove boto3 dependency, remove AWS credentials from settings
Update _setup_llm() to use ChatGoogleGenerativeAI (gemini-3.5-flash)
Verify GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings (text-embedding-004) works as primary
Remove os.environ blocks in agent.py, inject settings via DI
Clean config.py: pure BaseSettings, no os.getenv() defaults, no manual load_dotenv()
Rename Langsmith_API_KEY -> langsmith_api_key (snake_case)
Update .env.example: remove AWS keys, keep GEMINI_API_KEY
Remove unused GROQ_API_KEY and google_provider fallback flag

features.notes: Gemini 3.5 Flash is new (announced 2025). Verify langchain-google-genai supports it. Fallback provider logic should be generic pattern, not AWS-specific.

features.name: Data Pipeline — dbt + DuckDB + Airflow
features.description: Build a dbt project that transforms raw MySQL tables into analytics-ready DuckDB marts. Schedule via Airflow locally. Agent queries DuckDB, not raw MySQL.

tests.notes: Tests: dbt tests (not_null, unique, relationships), model compilation succeeds, Airflow DAG import test

subtasks.name: Initialize dbt project with dbt-duckdb adapter
Create staging models (stg_patient, stg_lob, stg_patient_score, etc.)
Create intermediate models (int_patient_scores, int_patient_conditions)
Create mart models (dim_patients, dim_conditions, fct_patient_metrics, fct_interventions)
Add dbt tests (not_null, unique, accepted_values, relationships)
Add dbt model documentation (descriptions for columns, tables)
Create Airflow DAG (caliperlens_pipeline) with docker-compose.airflow.yaml
Update SchemaRAG context library to describe DuckDB marts
Update SchemaGraph to reflect DuckDB mart schema (simpler joins)
Add make dbt-run target
Update .env.example with DuckDB path

features.notes: MySQL source DB retained (immutable source of truth). dbt runs are idempotent. DuckDB file mounts read-only into sandbox. Agent query complexity drops significantly (queries marts, not raw tables).

features.name: Sandbox — Docker-Isolated Code Execution
features.description: Run all agent-generated Python and SQL code inside Docker containers with --network none, CPU/memory caps, timeout, and read-only DB mounts.

tests.notes: Tests: verify network isolation (no outbound requests), resource cap enforcement, timeout kills rogue processes, read-only mount prevents writes

subtasks.name: Write sandbox/Dockerfile (python:3.12-slim + matplotlib)
Write sandbox/entrypoint.sh (accepts code via stdin or file mount)
Implement SandboxExecutor in backend/core/ with docker-py
Configure Docker run params: --network none, --cpus=1, --memory=256m, --pids-limit=50, 30s timeout
Mount DuckDB file read-only, mount writable /tmp for artifacts
Capture stdout, stderr, exit code, output files from container
Wire SandboxExecutor into agent tool definitions
Add health check: verify sandbox Docker image exists and is runnable

features.notes: This provides the security boundary for all agent-generated code. No agent code runs directly in the backend process. The sandbox is a prerequisite for F011 (Analysis + Charts).

features.name: Eval Harness — NL-to-SQL Quality Measurement
features.description: Create 20-25 NL questions with expected SQL structures and result shapes. Scripted runner reports pass-rate and auto-repair-rate. CI runs it on every push.

tests.notes: Tests: verify all 20-25 questions parse correctly, runner CLI works, validation checks catch known-bad SQL

subtasks.name: Define eval question schema (question, expected_sql_contains, expected_result_shape, category)
Write 20-25 questions covering: simple_select, filtered_select, join, aggregation, multi_step, edge_cases
Implement runner.py (sends questions to /api/v1/chat, validates SQL + result shape)
Implement SQL structure validation (contains expected clauses, LIMIT check, org_id filter check)
Implement result shape validation (type check, row count range, value range)
Calculate pass-rate and auto-repair-rate metrics
Add make eval target
Add GitHub Actions job to run eval on push

features.notes: This is the baseline measurement tool. Must be implemented before any agent behavior changes (F007 planner, F010 analysis) so we can measure improvement. Runner should handle agent non-determinism (same question can produce validly-different SQL).

features.name: Planner + Multi-turn Memory
features.description: Add a planner node that decomposes complex questions into ordered multi-step plans. Track plan execution state. Re-plan on failure. Preserve conversation context across messages in a session.

tests.notes: Tests: planner generates valid plan structure, re-planning triggers on failure, multi-turn context preserves prior queries

subtasks.name: Define plan Pydantic schema (steps with action type, description, status)
Implement planner LangGraph node (generates ordered plan from user question)
Implement task-state tracking (plan_state dict with per-step pending/running/done/failed)
Implement conditional edge: on step failure, route back to planner with error context
Update validate_answer_node to detect step-level failure (not just query failure)
Enable multi-turn memory (preserve chat history across messages in session)
Update frontend to display plan progress (step counter, current step description)
Add planning-related prompts to prompt_module.py

features.notes: This is the biggest agent capability upgrade. The planner node sits before table discovery. Plans support step types: query, analyze, chart. Multi-turn memory leverages existing MemorySaver + session_id system.

features.name: Auth + Security
features.description: JWT-based API authentication, per-user rate limiting, read-only DB credentials, secrets audit. Hardcoded org_id becomes JWT-claims-based.

tests.notes: Tests: JWT token validation, rate limiter enforcement, read-only DB user cannot write, org_id scoping works per-user

subtasks.name: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/login with JWT (access + refresh tokens)
Add FastAPI dependency to validate Authorization header on all /api/v1/* endpoints
Implement per-user rate limiting on /api/v1/chat (slowapi or Redis counter)
Create read-only MySQL user for dbt extracts, read-only DuckDB user for agent
Make org_id configurable from JWT claims, remove hardcoded org_id=16
Secrets audit: no keys in logs, traces, error messages. LangSmith trace sanitization.
Update .env.example with JWT_SECRET_KEY and rate limit config

features.notes: Rate limiting prevents Gemini API cost abuse. Read-only DB access is a defense-in-depth measure alongside sandbox isolation. org_id scoping prevents cross-org data access.

features.name: Infra + CI — Docker Compose + GitHub Actions
features.description: Containerize backend. Docker-compose for full local stack (backend, Airflow, Prometheus, Grafana, sandbox). GitHub Actions CI pipeline.

tests.notes: Tests: docker-compose spins up successfully, health check reports all services OK, CI workflow triggers on push

subtasks.name: Write Dockerfile for FastAPI backend (multi-stage, gunicorn + uvicorn)
Write docker-compose.yaml (backend + Airflow webserver/scheduler/postgres + Prometheus + Grafana + sandbox)
Add make infra-up and make infra-down targets
Add GET /api/v1/health with downstream dependency checks
Write .github/workflows/ci.yaml (make setup, make style, make test, make eval)
Add README badges (build status, license, tech stack)

features.notes: CI eval-on-push is critical for agent quality regression prevention. docker-compose local stack is the primary deployment model (frontend on Vercel, everything else local).

features.name: Observability — LangSmith + Prometheus + Grafana + Structured Logging
features.description: Full tracing via LangSmith. Prometheus metrics from FastAPI. Grafana dashboard. Structured JSON logging with trace IDs for end-to-end run reconstruction.

tests.notes: Tests: Prometheus /metrics endpoint exposes expected counters, Grafana dashboard JSON is valid, log lines include trace_id

subtasks.name: Enable LangSmith full tracing (node-by-node graph execution, tool calls, retries)
Instrument FastAPI with prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator (/metrics endpoint)
Add custom metrics: per-LangGraph-node execution time, sandbox execution time, error rate by type
Configure Prometheus in docker-compose (scrape backend /metrics)
Build Grafana dashboard JSON: p95/p99 latency, plan success rate, sandbox time, error rates, cost per query
Convert logger to python-json-logger with trace_id, session_id, node_name fields
Propagate trace_id through graph nodes and tool calls

features.notes: All monitoring runs locally (Prometheus + Grafana in docker-compose). LangSmith is the only cloud dependency here (SaaS). Structured logging enables grep-based debugging alongside dashboards.

features.name: Analysis + Charts — Sandboxed Statistics and Visualization
features.description: Agent can perform statistical analysis and generate charts via sandboxed Python execution. Return structured analysis and chart images to the frontend.

tests.notes: Tests: analysis routine returns correct stats, chart generation produces valid PNG, sandbox rejects malicious code, output contracts validated

subtasks.name: Define analysis output Pydantic schema (stats dict, trend detection results)
Implement analysis code template (descriptive stats, linear regression for trends)
Define chart output Pydantic schema (chart_type, chart_data_base64, title)
Implement chart code template (matplotlib: bar, line, scatter, histogram, pie)
Wire sandbox execution into planner step types (analyze, chart)
Add output contract validation (Pydantic schema check on sandbox return)
Add tool definitions so agent can dispatch analyze/chart steps
Update frontend ChatMessage to render charts (base64 images)
Update frontend ChatMessage to render analysis tables

features.notes: Dependent on F004 (sandbox) and F006 (planner). No plotly (keeps sandbox image small). matplotlib pre-installed in sandbox Dockerfile. Chart artifacts returned as base64-encoded PNGs to avoid file serving complexity.
